home.welcome_text: Welcome to Great Commission Bible Church. We are a community of believers dedicated to spreading the Gospel and making disciples. Join us as we worship, learn, and grow together in faith.

February.title: An invitation to celebrate pt.1
February.summary: The leaders and people of Israel gave willingly to the construction of the Temple. The people rejoiced at its completion, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord for the building of His Temple.

February.title: An invitation to celebrate pt.2 (Invitation, Participation, Rejoicing)
February.summary: We are part of the Body of Christ, built on the foundation of the apostles and the prophets, with Christ as the chief cornerstone. We are built together to be a dwelling (a Holy Temple for God), in which God lives by His Holy Spirit.
key_points: Invitation :- God invites us to participate in a glorious celebration. It's a journey that requires us to Listen, Submit, and Rejoice.
We are to listen as God calls, submitting outselves to Him as a living sacrifice (Romans 12: 1-2)
Participation :- We are to willingly give of our time, abilities, resources etc. We are to get involved.
Rejoicing :- We rejoice at the outcome as we are  willing, enthusiastic and grateful to be part of the Body of Christ (His Temple).

July.title: The secret to wholeness
July.summary: 10 lepers cried out to Jesus for help. They did what he told them and were healed. Only 1 returned with thanksgiving to God. Jesus declared to him 'your Faith has made you whole'. Godliness with contentment is great gain (1 Tim 6:6).
key_points: God has mercy on us even though we don't deserve it.
He extends promises to us when we obey His Word.
Faith works with you and God together.
All were healed, but only one returned with thanksgiving.
Will God lose you after you receive your miracle?
The secret to wholeness — be grateful for the miracles you already have in your life.

July.title: Faith makes things possible
July.summary: Now Faith is the assurance (confirmation) of things hoped for (divinely guaranteed), and the evidence of things not seen (the conviction of their reality — faith comprehends as fact what cannot be seen). For by this kind of Faith, the men of old gained (divine) approval. By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God's command, so that what is seen was not made from what is visible.
key_points: We are not of those who shrink back.
Faith causes us to receive understanding.
Faith causes action.
Faith illuminates the mind.
Faith comes from hearing the Word of God.

July.title: Encouragement for believers
key_points: Humility:
Consider others above yourself (Phil 2:3).
God opposes the proud, but shows favour to the humble (1 Peter 5:5).
Wisdom comes by humility (Pro 11:2).
Faithfulness:
God has compassion for us daily (Lam 3:22-23).
God is faithful to us, we need to be faithful to Him (2 Tim 2:13).
Learning:
Be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to get angry (James 1:19).
Ask God — He will give us wisdom and He gives liberally (James 1:5).
Continue the process of learning; get wisdom, knowledge and understanding (Pro 4:7).

July.title: Keeping Faith alive
July.summary: The race of life cannot be avoided. We must stay on course. Our race is already won. Our competitors are not flesh and blood. Run the race marked out for you. The Champion is Jesus.
key_points: Community:
We are surrounded by 'a cloud of witnesses' — we are to be encouraged by those who have gone before us and by our community of believers.
Focus:
Look to Jesus.
Keep your eyes on the end of the age.
Remind yourself of what the Bible says.
Discipline:
Resist sin with everything you have.
Embrace correction.
Do not fear discipline.
Discipline has its own reward.

August.title: Revelation Chapters 2 & 3 — The Seven Churches
August.summary: Reflecting on spiritual status and caution for believers everywhere. The message of the seven churches is a message for all believers, everywhere for all time. Let us do our best to persevere amidst challenges that come up against us.

items: Ephesus - The church that left its first love. Council: Don't lose your love for God's truth or His peace
Smyrna - The church facing heavy persecution. Council: Remain faithful in the face of tribulation and poverty
Pergamum - The church that needed to turn away from sin. Council: Resist Satan's influence, even to death if necessary
Thyatira - The church dealing with false teachings. Council: Resist false teaching
Sardis - The sleeping church that needed to wake up. Council: Remain zealous and pure in conduct
Philadelphia - The faithful church that persevered. Council: Persevere and walk through the door God opens
Laodicea - The lukewarm church. Council: Don't become casual about God's way of life

August.title: Revelation 4 — The Throne Room of Heaven
August.summary: John sees a door standing open in heaven; the voice he heard before said to him, 'Come up here and I will show you things which must take place after this!'

key_points.heading: The environment:
items: A Throne — the One sitting on it was brilliant like gemstones, and an emerald circled the throne like a rainbow
A sea of glass like crystal
Flashes of lightning, thunderings and voices
7 lamps of fire, which were the 7 Spirits of God (the Holy Spirit in His fulness)
Around the Throne were 24 thrones with 24 Elders sitting on them, clothed in white with gold crowns on their heads
Four living creatures, each covered with eyes — the first like a lion, the second like an ox, the third with a human face, and the fourth like a flying eagle
There was continuous worship

August.title: Revelation 5 — The Worthiness of Jesus
August.summary: John sees a scroll in the right hand of the One sitting on the throne, written on the inside and outside and sealed with seven seals. A strong angel asks 'Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?' No one in heaven, on earth or under the earth was found worthy — except the Lamb of God who has conquered (Isaiah 53:7). He took the scroll from the One sitting on the throne, and the living creatures and the 24 Elders sang, 'You are worthy to take the scroll and open it, for You were killed and Your blood has ransomed people for God.' The worthiness of Jesus is infinitely important for the redemption of the world.

items: God created a perfect world for mankind.
Adam and Eve (the first humans) disobeyed God's instructions.
As a result all creation was affected by sin.
God then gave Moses the Law, His instructions for mankind.
It was a system of animal sacrifice for sin.
The Lamb (Jesus) fulfilled that system of animal sacrifice required by God, by dying on the cross and redeeming mankind.
His Word is now written on our hearts; we have to make the choice to follow them.
The only One who can redeem the earth was the Lamb who was slain.
He alone was found worthy to open the scroll and read it.

August.title: Revelation 6 — The Opening of the Seals
August.summary: The Lamb of God (Jesus) is found worthy to open the scroll and break its seals. As He breaks each seal, the horsemen are called forth by each of the Living Creatures — the four horsemen, harbingers of the end.

items: The first seal — The White Horse (The Conqueror): its rider wears a crown and holds a bow. Purpose: to conquer.
The second seal — The Fiery Red Horse (The Warmonger): its rider possesses a large sword. Purpose: given power to take peace from the earth and make people kill each other.
The third seal — The Black Horse (Famine): its rider holds a pair of scales. Purpose: to cause economic collapse.

The fourth seal — The Pale Horse (Death): its rider was called Death, and the realm of the dead followed behind. Purpose: given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine, plague and by beast.
Stand on behalf of believers (Acts 2:14) — Peter stood in defense of the believers as the crowd accused them of being drunk when they were filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in tongues.

Stand in support of those in need (Acts 3:6-8) — Peter and John encountered a man who was lame, begging for money. They didn't have money to give, but gave him what they had and healed him in the name of Jesus.
Stand in defence of the glorified Jesus (Acts 3:15) — Peter told the crowd they had killed the Author of life, but God had raised Him from the dead, and that the apostles had witnessed this fact.
Stand in defiance of false teaching (Acts 4:12) — Peter declared that salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name whereby we can be saved.

key_points.heading: Main points:
items: We are to defend our brothers and sisters in Christ when falsely accused.
Be willing to assist or help those in need, which includes using our gifts and abilities, depending on the Holy Spirit in everything.
Be willing to defend the cross of Jesus Christ.
We are to stand in defiance of false teaching when lies are accepted as truth.
How does Abel/Noah/Abraham/Moses/Rehab experience with God demonstrate walking in faith?
What are some of the ways our faith is challenged?
What can we do when our faith is challenged?
How do we keep our faith alive?
Create a scenario where someone's faith is challenged, and use biblical principles to overcome.

August.title: Securing your faith
August.summary: As we seek to ensure that we serve God continuously and faithfully, let us appreciate the importance of submitting ourselves, sharing the gospel and living a sacrificial life.

key_points.heading: Submission:
items: Follow the instructions of leaders
Examine the results of the life
Have an attitude of submission
Understand that their work is spiritual
Help them to help you

key_points.heading: Salvation (Gospel of):
items: Do not seek comfort
Go beyond your safe spaces
Identify with the shame of Christ (vs 13)
Carry the Word of God with you

key_points.heading: Sacrifice:
items: Jesus the ultimate and final Sacrifice for sin
We now offer sacrifices of praise (with our lips)
The evidence of our sacrificial heart is in doing good
God is pleased with us when we do good

August.title: What God wants us to do with His Word
August.summary: God exposes coming realities for the benefit of the Church of Jesus Christ.

key_points.heading: Be Encouraged:
items: The Church is provided with knowledge of future events that are unfolding
Nothing that is happening is a surprise to God and it should not be to the Church
We should be able to see the hand of God moving in all Earth's events

key_points.heading: Be Witnesses:
items: See God's Word unfolding (seek it out)
Spread the knowledge of the Gospel
Share with others, your experience with Jesus

key_points.heading: Be Obedient:
items: There is a blessing for those who obey
Stay in the Word of God (read it, listen to it, be where it is)
Follow the instructions the Word of God gives

August.title: Introduction to Revelation
August.summary: John writes to the seven churches in the province of Asia and relates to them what he saw in the vision he received from Jesus Christ.

items: The number 7 signifies completion, divine perfection
The number 6, the number of mankind, the 6th day of creation
The 7 churches applies also to the global church, the complete church
The Alpha and the Omega - the beginning and the end
Lampstands representing the source of light
Dressed in white speaks of purity
Verses 9-11 gives a clear imagery of Jesus dictating to John what he should write to the 7 churches
Jesus to John, 'Write what you have seen, what is now and what will take place'

July.title: Disaster Preparedness Tips
steps: Trim trees and keep home surroundings clear of loose items.
Know the emergency numbers.
Learn to shut off your home's gas, electricity and water.
Choose a meeting place outside of home in case of separation or evacuation.
Store bottled water, non-perishable food items & manual opener.
Prepare first aid kit, essential medications, medical devices etc.
Secure important documents.
Keep portable phone chargers, flashlights with extra batteries.
Keep updated to local alerts and follow instructions.
did_you_know: The word "Bible" comes from the Greek term ta biblia, which literally translates to "the books".
The phrase "Do not be afraid" or "Fear not" is traditionally said to appear 365 times — one for every day of the year.

August.title: Scriptural prayer on behalf of believers
steps: Ask God to fill us with the Knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding (Col 1:9).
That we may walk worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing Him, being fruitful in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God (Col 1:10).
For us to be strengthened with all might according to His glorious power, so that we may have all the patience and endurance we need, with joy (Col 1:11).
That we will be able to understand, as all God's people should know, how wide, how long, how high and how deep the love of Christ really is (Eph 3:18).
That we will always give thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share the inheritance of the saints who live in the light. (Col 1:12).

featured_testimony.name: Sister Lee
featured_testimony.testimony: My mother faithfully did her best to teach me about Jesus. I actually understood in my early 20’s that God’s ways are better than my ways when I became a single mother.  I believe I was told by God Himself in my darkest moment,  “But Jesus forgives sin”.  Looking back, I think this was the point when I made Jesus my “Saviour”  because there was nothing I could do about my sin. It took another a few years, to learn and understand that God  redeems sin - past, present and future, and could and would work it for my good and His glory (Romans 8:28, Isaiah 61:1-4).  I was ALL in! I surrendered my life to Jesus to be used for His eternal purposes. I now know this is what it means to make Jesus my “Lord”.  The Lord was and continued to be faithful to His sanctifying work and establishing my identity as His daughter over the next 20 years. I continually sought to serve Him - my passion and sweet spot being facilitating ladies Bible study, sharing what I was learning. But, there was more. Around turning 50, God began to show me my need for His healing love that deepens and seals a trusting relationship with Him; no doubts and fears about His sovereignty over my life no matter the stormy circumstances. This is the place of true rest for my soul. There are not enough words to express my gratitude.

verse_of_the_month.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

featured_testimony.name: Dianne Charles
featured_testimony.testimony:
My name is Dianne Charles and I was christened into the Roman Catholic Faith and followed the traditions of that religion. While practicing my faith, inwardly I questioned some of their cultural practices and teachings, but went along with them.

Their teaching of purgatory after death as a temporal place until purification gave me a false hope, that I will still have a chance of eternal salvation after purification, which will enable me to achieve the holiness necessary to enter the joy of heaven.

However Great Commission Bible Church hosted a missionary outreach in my Apartment Building, after which I started to fellowship with the church. I was baptized into Christianity on July 6th 2003 and have seen God working in my life in ways that I could never have imagined and there is no turning back.

In hindsight I would now realize that when I was approached by the Pastor of GCBC to be a member of the Leadership Committee, he was being lead by the Holy Spirit and a call to Ministry. This calling has encouraged me to read more of God's Word to build a personal relationship with Him. I believe in his promises which gives me greater assurance that He will guide me according to James 1:5 which says "But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all generously and without reproach and it will be given to him".

Being a member of the Leadership Committee has also allowed me to use my Spiritual Gift of Administration and by extension gave me the opportunity to participate in the many ministries of the Church. In the performance of these duties I have developed a bond with my sisters especially through our Prayer Group and Ladies Group. I am now able to identify when one of them is hurting in silence, the bond which I share with them gives me the confidence to approach them with an aim to listen, guide and/or assist in any way that I can. I am therefore seeing the spiritual gift of mercy manifesting itself more and more in my life.

I continue to thank God for giving me the wisdom and guidance as I endeavor to do my best while I strive for excellence.

verse_of_the_month.text: Turn away from evil and do good, seek peace and pursue it.

featured_testimony.name: Testimony Time
featured_testimony.testimony:
Summary of testimonies during Testimony time:
1. Being thankful for meeting a stranger years ago and developing a dependable lasting friendship of support and encouragement for each other.
2. An account of a work related meeting that led to discussions on a Bible verse about leaving evil behind and actively pursuing peace.
3. Giving thanks to God for the way He picks us up when we lose our focus, similarly to how Jesus reached out and rescued Peter when he started to walk on the water but instead focused on his surroundings and began to sink.
4. Encouragement from 1 John 5:14 which states we can be confident that God hears us when we ask anything according to His will, and if we know He hears us, we can be sure that He will give us what we asked for.
5. A testimony of being grateful to God for allowing that person to be a good witness when others are looking on, instead of being a stumbling block to them.
6. Thanking God for clearing the lanes of a busy highway in order to safely reach on the Shoulder during a dangerous vehicular emergency.
7. Giving thanks to God for waking them from sleep to be aware of a leaking gas tank and protecting the family from what could have been a dangerous situation.

verse_of_the_month.text: You are worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honor and power. For you created everything, and it is for your pleasure that they exist and were created.

featured_testimony.name: Sister Kizzie Hope
featured_testimony.testimony: My family grew up going to church and doing church, so church life was a part of my life from a very young age. I remember going to church in the evening and sleeping during church and my parents waking me up when it was time to leave. I've always loved church until I didn't. I got baptised as a child somewhere between the ages of 10 - 12 years old. I remember preparing to go into Secondary School and reminding myself not to become influenced by my potential new friends. As time passed I remember wanting to hang out with a different crowd other than my own circle of 'good' friends. I wanted to be with the more popular girls but I couldn't. At 16 years old, around  the time of exams,CXC, as it was called then, I prayed and asked God to change my affections and desires. I asked him to be Lord of my life for real this time. I made a committment to Him that He would be ruler over my thoughts, decisions, and my actions. I was discipled by my pastor who allowed our group to ask as many questions as we'd wanted and was taught how to read the bible. Since then,  I have had to re commit certain aspects of my life to God several times over.  Now, on my 'bad' days, I am reminded that although the grass seems greener on the other side, it is not.  Although, my walk with God has not been an easy journey,  I have lived long enough to know that there isn't a better option available. God is able to keep that which I have committed unto Him until that day.
